title: The nonmaximal anti-de Sitter enclosing-area inequality
exact_target: For smooth complete one-ended orientable three-dimensional asymptotically hyperbolic exteriors with cosmological constant $-3$, compact smooth boundary, the stated weighted-integrable DEC and $O_{2,\alpha }/O_{1,\alpha }$ hyperbolic-norm decay of rate $3/2<\tau <3$, future-timelike metric mass covector and $H+\operatorname{tr}_S$ $K\leq 0$ on every boundary component, is $m_AH\geq (r_A+r_A^3)/2$ for $r_A=\operatorname{sqrt}(A_min/(4\pi ))$? No maximality, compact-topology, boundary-genus or outermostness restriction is imposed; ask for the stated connected nondegenerate original-data Schwarzschild–AdS equality rigidity.
